subject: Synapses turned over constantly while their excitatory-inhibitory balance held
script: From Agewell Brief: Synapses turned over constantly while their excitatory-inhibitory balance held. New live-imaging research reveals that excitatory and inhibitory synapses remodel continuously, yet their overall balance remains steady—a finding with deep implications for brain health and aging. Your brain is not a static machine. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
